4.3.12 Value Bitfield Error Handling
The Bitfield Errors are introduced in order to give the software components extra infor-
mation about the errors occurred during the read processing. This extra information
is added as optional parameter to the RTE calls Rte_Read and Rte_Receive. The
extra information includes the following:
• The out-of-range error bitfield which shall contain the information of out-of-range
error of the flattened child elements of the enclosing structure.
• The invalid value error bitfield which shall contain the information of invalid value
error of the flattened child elements of the enclosing structure.
[SWS_Rte_04674] Returning the Out of Range Details of Elements in Structure
⌈The RTE shall store out of range value errors in a bitfield for the flattened elements
in the structure if the outOfRangeBitfieldErrorsEnabled for the port mapped
to the signal is set to TRUE and the handleOutOfRange has any value other than
none.⌋
Note: It is not specifed by the RTE at which point in time the calcution of the out of
range bitfied happens and it is left to the implementer. Latest after Rte_Read or Rte_
Receive return the out of range bitfied has to be valid.
Example: If the Rte API Calls (e.g. Rte_Read) receives a structure of three elements
as shown the following figure and the value of Element1 and Element3 are out of range,
then the out of range value errors bitfield should have value 5 as shown the following
figure.
